findings: learner.overview: Distinguish the competing accounts instead of saying only “a direct numeral graph or a borrowed graph.” State that Shang 亖 is described as directly representing four and coexisted with forms written 四; identify counting rods as a separate interpretation of some 四 forms. Then distinguish the two borrowing proposals: one treats 四 as a breath-related graph for 呬, later borrowed for four because of a proposed sound similarity, with the referent’s ancient name unknown; the other treats 四 as the original graph for 泗 (“nasal discharge”), later borrowed for four, and is noted as lacking textual attestation. Cite the corresponding claims with X-e6d62080b1a5fc5178a4, X-7b17032f87fb77433387, X-2723cf5f9190c41c2cfe, and X-4b62255296f832195814. The attached image shows a Shuowen-style redraw and does not resolve these competing accounts.
